With the new Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: Evolution DLC nearing release, and with it continuing the story of humanity's fight against the Machines, against Legion, we wanted to take you back to the battlefield to refresh your memory of the story so far.

The story so far \[Spoilers]

The DLC’s that have been released have continued the story on from what was set in the original base game.

The base game followed Lieutenant Alex Church from his first command within the Founders, fighting back against Legion, finding himself and his force adrift in the wastelands, and finding allies in the form of the Movement, the civilian militia, that he managed to bring together into a Resistance force. Towards the end of the campaign, a giant Mech, using unknown digital technology was destroyed and that technology, named ‘The Digital Storm’, became a winning tool in the final battle against legion at Galverston, where Legion technology development, including creating human-skinned infiltrator Terminators, was halted, and some Legion technology taken by the Founders.

The first DLC, We Are Legion saw the war from the Machines point of view, as Legion identified the ‘Digital Storm’ weapon that had been used towards the end of the base game, and it tried to find out about, and capture that technology. Splitting off ‘Units’ from itself, we followed Unit 1462 as it made contact with the Integrators, and used Acolyte Silas to help it find out about Digital Storm.

candidates.title: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: We are Legion - Dev Diary #3
candidates.text:
We next see Stevens 10 years later, in the fight against Legion. Now a Major in the Founders force, a faction composed of the remnants of the US military. Major Stevens is bringing Lieutenant Alex Church (our main protagonist) to a Founder’s outpost for one of his first commanding roles. What follows includes a Legion convoy with human prisoners, Church making the decision to return to the Founder’s base, Haven, with the prisoners, and a subsequent attack by Legion, with Haven base ultimately being lost.

This leaves Church and his small team of Founder survivors cast into the wasteland, with Legion hot on their trail. With manpower low, the team, nicknamed ‘T-Force’, start to make an allegiances with The Movement, made up of a militia from the civilian survivors who have banded together to fight back against the Machines.

During this period, T-Force also meets ‘The Integrators’, a cult of humans that worship all things technology, to the point of speaking and acting like machines. They see the way of the Machine to be the true way forwards. As a faction, they scavenge technology and produce hi-tech weaponry and equipment, often splicing human and Legion tech together to make hybrid weapons and vehicles. Partly nomadic, there are Integrator settlements scattered around the south of the US.

candidates.title: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: Unveiling the Founders
candidates.text:
The backbone of the Founders' forces, standard infantry squads consist of seven highly versatile combat units. Equipped to engage both light and heavy enemy units, these squads serve as the universal combat backbone of the faction. Upgrades offer options such as improved weaponry and expanded ammo capacity. With these enhancements, the standard infantry squads become even more formidable in battle.
Just like other units in the game, the Founders’ units can undergo training and improvement to unlock their unique special abilities. This allows players to further tailor their strategies and maximise the potential of their forces. Infantry within the Founders can undergo a range of upgrades to further enhance their combat effectiveness. These upgrades include improved body armour, providing increased survivability and reduced speed. Furthermore, infantry units can receive an extended set of ammunition for their bazookas, granting them a wider range of destructive capabilities. In addition to the cumulative anti-tank rounds, they gain access to high-explosive anti-personnel ammunition.

As you embark on the journey through Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance, be prepared to witness the relentless determination and battle-hardened spirit of the Founders. This faction embodies the unwavering resilience of the U.S. military and becomes a beacon of hope in the war against Legion. Upgrade your units, hone your tactics, and join the Founders in the ultimate fight for humanity's survival.

Stay tuned for more updates as we delve deeper into the factions and the immersive world of Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance. Prepare to make your mark on the battlefield and shape the destiny of mankind.

candidates.text:
Legion's path met Alex Church and his Resistance, and later attacked the core of the Founders forces, to discover and capture Digital Storm. It found that Digital Storm was a sentient AI that the Founders had ‘discovered’, from an earlier time in the 90’s, but utilized some ‘strange future code’ that Silas couldn’t understand.

We Are Legion ends with Unit 1462 being infected with the Digital Storm’s code base, and after a confrontation with Legion itself, Unit 1462 is left for dead, only to be ‘discovered’ and re-booted by Elder Silas himself.

The last DLC, Uprising, we returned to the fight of the Resistance as Alex Church and a portion of the Resistance forces are ‘searching in the North’ for more humans to join the Resistance. As the structure of Uprising is more ‘fluid’ and open, it is up to each individual player what the outcome of that campaign was, but pushing back the Machine hordes was the goal.

The Story Continues \[More Spoilers]

And so we move North and come to the new Evolution DLC. This continues the story set out in the earlier DLC’s \[spoilers ahead].

The new campaign DLC continues the story of Alex Church, the Integrator Silas and the Legion Unit 1462 and their fights against Legion, or for their other goals.

When a large Legion mining and operation in Canada forces an Integrator army, led by Silas to seek out the support of the only force that he knows that could help them destroy these operations, Alex Church and his Resistance.

candidates.title: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance review
candidates.text: As a child, I adored the Terminator movies. I even appreciated the concept behind the Dark Fate movie. However, this game truly excels in capturing the atmosphere. It genuinely feels as though the situation is dire and intense. After all, battling against machines is expected to be challenging.In any case, if you grew up watching the movies and loved them, give this game a try; you can always request a refund if it’s not to your liking.

candidates.title: Evolution | Dev Diary #2
candidates.text:
Well, I am very excited about the new Rev melee functionality. The new DLC was built around this new unit type and new melee functionality and improvement, both in story and functionality. I was blown away seeing the Revs leaping onto a moving vehicle and begin ripping it apart. The initial plan wasn’t to have them attacking vehicles, but I remember when the team mentioned “oh, and we may look to get them leaping onto and attacking vehicles, ripping them apart”, I was like “Oh, yes please, if you can, that would look awesome!”

My main concern as always is player expectation. I see player comments such as “I hope there is more than 3 - 4 days worth of play”. The new DLC is comparable to the “We Are Legion” DLC released earlier in length, with a similar amount of missions. Whenever you release a new game or DLC, you just hope players enjoy it.

From DAMIR

Is there going to be a DLC in which the integrators will get a flying vehicle/unit

Be it a advanced heli or a legions HK aerial they took/hacked and modified for their use

Mark:
Well, the Integrators are quite prevalent and playable in the new Evolution DLC allowing the player to control them (with the return of Silas from We Are Legion DLC!). But there is no additional Integrator aerial unit, but a great idea that will be put to the team for future DLC. I know players cry out for more flying units.

From Nikita

Will the upgrade / Promotion system be further expanded on?

Mark:

As I mentioned above, there is now another level of ability upgrades with augmentations available. I believe that a unit needs to have upgraded to at least an Expert to have the option of augmentation too.

From Xul:

Can the augmented humans board and rip apart vehicles?

Mark:
No, augmented people have weapons. They can only deal with vehicles with these weapons.

candidates.title: Hughmungus November Status Update is Here!
candidates.text:
Our system prioritises tasks for Nuggets dynamically. This allows us to quantity the number of available Nuggets vs busy Nuggets. If there is a need for extra stone, the system will not send all 20 Idle/Free Nuggets to mine stone. The system will task Nuggets to the job one by one and check the weight of that need based on the amount of Nuggets now assigned to it. This way, the system dynamically assigns Nuggets jobs based on the current situation, and it no longer prioritises one job above all else when assigning them. It will only send 5 Nuggets to help build a Hut instead of sending 20 of the available group, because the system now understand that 5 Nuggets are more than enough to finish the task.
Nuggets will also understand if certain buildings need extra support (like Eateries, Farms, etc) and automatically assign themselves to those buildings. If a Farmer dies of old age or from the unfortunate and somehow all too common event that a mammoth stepped on them (how didn’t they see it coming?), another Nugget will fill this position without your interaction.
Our goal is to make Nuggets feel alive. We want you to feel like they are truly organic, living beings.

candidates.title: The Universim review
candidates.text: This is a brilliant game with so much potential but it is impossible to keep a population of nuggets. Once you start getting to the 300+ it will decrease inexplicably making it impossible to progress. Population system needs massive work.

candidates.title: INTRODUCING A HUNTING SYSTEM
candidates.text:
Medium-sized animals
Wolves, foxes, bears, and deer are dangerous animals and require more skill to be caught by Nuggets. A Nugget will never succeed on their own. You will need to gather 2 or more Nuggets together in the Hunting Hut to have any chance of success. Keep in mind that these animals will recognize weak hunters and fight back.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9885158/ae5948c4be0865f8341d7e0b1d35f4b414be9cb7.jpg

Large Animals
These are very powerful and meaty animals, but they are slow and easy to keep up with. Animals such as mammoths, giraffes, whales, and rhinos are remarkably difficult to catch and require at least 6 Nuggets to be present in order to succeed.

TRAPS

Nuggets can also plant traps to catch wandering animals around the Epicenter. Each Hunting Hut possesses 1 trap that requires time and resources to be assembled. The assembly time depends on the size of the trap and the amount of Nuggets assigned to the Hunting Hut. The more Nuggets in the hut, the faster the trap will be assembled.

candidates.title: Crime in The Universim
candidates.text:
Assigning Law Enforcement Officers can lead to a significant decrease in criminal activity, but adding too many officers will make Nuggets feel oppressed and controlled. The more officers you have, the more unhappy they may become.

Crime Levels

- Very Low
- Low
- Moderate
- High - Creates Dangerous Criminals
- Very High - Creates Dangerous Criminals

Each level will also change how often criminals are spawned.

Types of Criminals

Thug - Vandalism and thievery.
Dangerous Criminal - Terrorists who constantly seek to harm the civilization and their fellow Nuggets. They can destroy food supplies, poison Wells, or even create large explosions to destroy buildings and nearby Nuggets.

Criminals have individual skill levels, with every successful crime increasing this level. As they level up, they become more difficult to catch. They will be smarter and more calculated with how they perform their crimes, making them less suspicious to Law Enforcers. Criminals perform a certain animation every now and then when doing something illegal. These animations are longer and more noticeable with low-level criminals.

candidates.title: INTRODUCING A HUNTING SYSTEM
candidates.text:
You can only place one trap of any type per hunting hut. Each trap has a radius that will attract an animal with a particular scent. As soon as an animal steps foot into the zone, it will be attracted to the trap by bait. Nuggets will collect animals from traps once they return from a hunt. Once the trap is used, it will be completely broken, so you will need to build a new one or select the built one already.

THE HUNT

Hunting Huts can hold up to 6 Nuggets at a time once all available slots are researched and unlocked. Larger animals require more Nuggets to be caught successfully. Assigned Nuggets will gather around a fire, and they might even break out into a hearty song! Hunters will wait around the fire until everyone has regained their strength and eaten. Once everyone is ready, the hunt will begin. Nuggets will choose their prey based on the target size you selected. They will approach the animal until they get within range to throw their stones, spears, or fire a rifle. Each attack is dynamic, which means that Nuggets have the potential to miss.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9885158/89ff8759536636f6d334820ac28f183176e76077.jpg

THE CHASE

Once startled, an animal will start running away, unless it decides that it has a better chance by fighting back. Nuggets will then begin pursuit. At some point, the animal will stop with the hope that it escaped from danger. However, as you know, Nuggets are rather persistent about certain things. They will never be too far behind. Nuggets will repeat this behavior until the animal is dead.

- Added the ability to drop dead Nuggets into the cemetery in a similar way to how resources are being dropped for the buildings
- Added the ability to drop crops into the farm in a similar manner to how resources are being dropped for the buildings
- Added lights to modern buildings to glow at night

candidates.title: Persona 3 Reload review
candidates.text: Finally completed my first playthrough of P3R. The unique immersion that the Persona series offers is unmatched, thanks to ATLUS. Each game in the series has its own profound theme: Persona 5 embodies the spirit of rebellion, Persona 4 is about the pursuit of truth, and Persona 3 delves into the meaning of life and death. These themes feel like they fill a gap in the education we receive.Finishing the game left me with deep reflections. The meaning of life seems to lie in the bonds we create with others—friendship, love, and family. It’s about following your heart, challenging what you can change, and accepting your limitations.It’s through this journey that we develop a fear of death, realizing how much we stand to lose. But in the end, death doesn’t seem so frightening. When your eyelids grow heavy, you can close your eyes, knowing that the bonds you’ve created will always be there to protect you.

candidates.title: eFootball™ review
candidates.text: PES used to be my childhood. A game that i played 3-4 hours a day, nearly everyday. I owned pes 2008, 2009, 2013, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021 and finally this abomination called e football. I will explain why i truly hate this game and i would never buy it if it wasnt f2p. At first glance, this game gives the impression that it respects its roots. The gameplay elements that made PES the game it was, are here. The physics and movements are better than the competition. Small elements that make the game feel "real" are here. The GK movements seem authentic and the graphics are way better than version 0.x. However, this mist of originality gets dispersed when u reach div 4 in the game. From this point onwards, the game becomes P2W without admitting it. And thats not all. At this point, even some academic professor start to care enough (since the PES series is THAT old) to construct papers that prove that this game tries to imitate the success of League Of Legends -with the skin and events prices- without making the experience better for the player that actually plays. For example, we have 19-20 different versions of Messi, even though players like him are not the meta. Someone with no experience at the game thinks that messi will buy him success then logs in plays a match and witnesses his messi and squad get anhilated by simple controls that make defence so easy and scriptable. In other words, its not the P2W cards that are the main issue with the game, but the control scheme and script that makes players play a specific way in order to win games, while cultivating the feeling that better cards will win u more games. I BET 2000$ cash that the next moneygrab tactic this abomination of a Company will integrate in this game is a marketplace with guaranteed epics for 500 coins, which will make them more money while keeping the gameplay as toxic as it is now.

candidates.title: eFootball™ review
candidates.text: I hadn't played PES (aka eFootball) since the 2019 version. I was positively surprised! It's very good. But don't be fooled; there are still many things missing for it to be a football game that doesn't become repetitive and is worth our time.Pros: It's beautiful; Responsive (commands respond well); No bugs; The collectible player card system is awesome; Building your team is fun; Player reward system is really cool; Fun events.Cons: Limited commentary (you can win 20-0, and the commentary at the end of the match is the same); It's not possible to choose a commentary language other than PT-BR or Japanese (I like to switch it up because it gets repetitive); It's a bit 'Pay to Win' in PVP mode (but it feels great to win with a weaker team *lol); The special cards are totally unfair when it comes to getting a good player (e.g., 150 out of 150 players with overall ratings from 85 to 72; of course, it's going to be hard to get a good card); The types of game modes are limited; No MASTER LEAGUE – What?!? Every PES player loves Master League!!! @Konami No career mode; It's 48GB; that's a lot for a football game.Conclusion: The game is good, but it becomes totally uninteresting after a few days. Even career modes could get boring, so imagine without them!Recommended with reservations.

candidates.title: Warhammer 40,000: Chaos Gate - Daemonhunters review
candidates.text: Solid XCOM-like with an emphasis on the tactical side, somewhat akin to Gears: Tactics. Pros:+ Looks and sounds great. Terminator armour sounds suitably stompy. Space Marines shout horrible stuff at the enemy, convinced of their own superiority. They write stuff like DEATH and JUDGEMENT and DUTY all over their armour. It's gloriously over-the-top as 40k should be.+ Fun character classes that can be specced two or three different ways+ Fun cutscenes and story+ Great soundtrack and sound designCons:- Steep learning curve throughout with minimal hand holding. It's entirely possible to get yourself into an unwinnable situation very late in the campaign. Be prepared to keep multiple saves (although the save slot system only gives you 5, which is poor)- A fair amount of repetition in missions and levels which gets old eventually- Early on, you will not feel like the Emperor's finest. You will feel like the Emperor's finest beef jerky due to the regular kickings your marines receive on the battlefield- Some really bizarre random events on the strategic side of the game which will really screw up your campaign and feel unfairOverall:If you love the 40k theme, there's lots to enjoy here and a good campaign to explore. Otherwise, this is more middle of the road due to an undercooked strategic layer. It's not as replayable as XCOM 2, but then what is?

candidates.title: Super Robot Wars 30 review
candidates.text: For those unfamiliar, Super Robot Wars (SRW) is like a giant robot fans dream crossover game including many disparate anime and game series, presented in a grid based strategy game.This entry, the 30th anniversary game (kinda), has alot going for it in terms of diversity of series, including many established series as well as series new to the game. While I would say the default game roster is maybe average (or a little light) compared to some of the PS1/PS2 entries, the DLC does add quite a bit more series, pilots and machines. There are still enough series that there is bound to be at least 2-3 that you like and that should be enough to carry interest throughout.Game was pricey on release, but given the licensing required to release the game state-side I honestly am not that bothered by it.Really, I would say your enjoyment will mostly be based in the amount of fandom you have in the various series. If you like Gundam, there are 4(5) series represented in terms of pilots and units. If you like the Brave series (Gaogaigar, J-Decker) or even classics like L-Gaim there is enough to keep you going.Unlike traditional SRW games, aside from critical story points, you have a choice of which missions you want to take and you don't have to miss out on the ones you didn't select. So, you can play through a Rayearth mission and not worry about passing up a Getter mission since you can select it afterwords.So, I guess the short of it is that if you like enough of the series included and you enjoy strategy games it might be worth giving it a shot.

candidates.title: Dev Blog - Hive Scum: Class Design & Talents
candidates.text:
As we kept developing the Hive Scum we were able to expand on that, with the narrative and the gameplay elements building on each other, a back and forth that influenced not just the abilities and talents of the class, but also the weapons, how they’re used, and how everything looks. And this also led us to a few unique mechanics…

Chem Toxin

Unique to the Hive Scum, the Chem Toxin is a new mechanic coming to Darktide. Similar to Burn or Bleed, this homebrewed toxin is its own Damage Over Time effect which the Hive Scum can apply through various ways, such as some of the unique weapons or one of the Blitzes.

It is quite potent, and multiple applications can stack up until a certain limit. Certain talents also interact with the Chem Toxin by triggering effects when applying it and things of that nature (more on that further down!)

Stimm Lab: The Cartel Special

Another new mechanic unique to this is the Stimm Lab! Thanks to their underworld connections, the Hive Scum are able to get some special materials and make their own custom Stimms called the Cartel Special!

Just like the main talent tree, you gain 1 point to spend in the Stimm Lab for every level, picking different bonuses to add to your Cartel Special. Players who opt into making their custom

Stimms through the Lab will start each mission with their Stimm equipped and will be unable to use any of the Stimms found in missions.

This Cartel Special Stimm will recharge on its own, and the cooldown will depend on how many points you’ve spent in the Stimm Lab: the more potent the effect, the longer the cooldown!

This mechanic is optional: By not selecting any upgrades in the Stimm Lab, your Hive Scum will be able to use normal Stimms like the other classes.

Enter ‘Rampage!’ for 10s. For the duration, gain +50% Melee Strength, +20% Attack Speed and +25% Damage Reduction.

Landing Melee Strikes during the duration will extend it by 0.3 seconds. At 20 seconds, the duration will begin to greatly diminish.

Place a refitted Medical Crate on the ground, bolstering you and your allies. If you have a Stimm equipped (via the Stimm Lab or otherwise), Stimm Supply will consume it, copy its effects and disperse it to any nearby allies.

You and Allies in Coherency gain additional 10% Melee Damage.

You and Allies in Coherency gain additional 5% Critical Chance.

Vulture’s Mark

Killing a Specialist or Elite Enemy with a ranged weapon grants you a stack of Vulture’s Mark for 8 seconds (stacking 3 times).

Each stack grants +5% Ranged Damage, +5% Critical Chance and +5% Movement Speed.

While at max stacks, Specialist and Elite Ranged Kills also restore 15% Toughness to you and Allies in coherency.

candidates.text:
Melee Hits grants you a stack of Adrenaline. Critical Melee Hits grants 1 additional stack. Not gaining a stack within 2 seconds will remove a stack instead.

At 30 stacks, you gain Adrenaline Frenzy for 10s, granting you +25% Melee Damage and +10% Attack Speed for the duration.

Reaching Adrenaline Frenzy again during its duration will refresh it.

Chemical Dependency

Using a Stimm (any Stimm) grants you a stack of Dependency for 90 seconds. For each stack, gain +10% Ability Cooldown Reduction. Stacks 3 times, decaying one at a time.

[img src="

Weapons

[img src=" align="right"]“Wrong man in the right place ah?”

Direct and unsophisticated, the Crowbar is the go-to tool of Hive Scums with a slugger inclination. Its generous Damage, Impact and Stamina values make the Crowbar an easy to use and dependable weapon.

Through its Special action, the grip on the weapon can be altered to swiftly access different moveset types, allowing it to deal with any surprise in the battlefield.

The Crowbar also has the newly introduced Charged Swings effect on its Heavy attacks: the more time a Heavy windup is maintained, the more Strength will be added to the following attack (up to +22.5% total Strength generated over 3 steps, with a similar timing as the Thrust Blessing).

Weapon Special

The Special action switches the grip on the Crowbar between the primary “Blunt” and secondary “Beak” modes, changing the moveset and the properties of the attacks.

In primary mode, attacks have increased Cleave and inflict good Impact also to secondary enemies hit during the swing. In secondary mode, attacks remain stuck deep into the first enemy hit, to be then yanked out for an additional instance of Damage and Impact.

candidates.title: Dev Blog - Hive Scum: Class Design & Talents
candidates.text:
Coherency Aura: Ruffian

Increased Melee damage for you and Allies in Coherency.

Blitz: Boom Bringer

A high powered missile launcher. What else is there to say? For when you really want something dead!

“That was so much fun. The idea came pretty early on because we were like ‘if we make a projectile weapon only exist as a Blitz, we can really crank the effect’. Because we can make sure that it doesn’t have too much ammo, or crazy numbers or doesn’t scale weird.” ~ Teodor

Combat Ability: Rampage!

“We wanted a ‘rage’ ability where you become unstoppable for a few seconds, as long as you play really aggressively and kill lots of things.” ~ Teodor

Enter Rampage! for a few seconds, gaining vastly increased Melee Attack power, Attack Speed, Damage Reduction, and becoming immune to Stuns and Suppression.

Melee attacks extend the duration of Rampage!, although this effect is diminished after 30 seconds. Exiting Rampage! leaves you exhausted and vulnerable for a few seconds.

Keystone: Adrenaline Frenzy

A very aggressive keystone that encourages relentless brawling!

Melee hits grant stacks of Adrenaline, which are lost over time when not attacking. At max stacks, lose all stacks and gain Adrenaline Frenzy, increasing Attack Speed and Melee Damage for a few seconds.

“Chemist”

Found on the right branch of the Talent Tree, this archetype puts a bigger focus on the unique Stimm and Toxin mechanics of the Hive Scum, gaining bonuses related to using Stimms (whether it’s the Cartel Special from the Stimm Lab or normal Stimms found in missions) and applying Chem Toxin through various methods (including weapons! More on that in a future dev blog).

candidates.title: Dev Blog - Hive Scum: Weapons
candidates.text:
The needle itself doesn’t deal much damage, but the Chem Toxin it applies is lethal enough, and it’s what the weapon relies on the most. Make each shot count, because the Needle Pistol has a more limited ammo pool than other weapons.

“It’s a lot of value per shot, but it also kills slower inherently by being Damage Over Time. You can also choose to pump your target full of toxin for a quick kill.” ~ Erik

It sports two firing modes, which you can switch between with the Weapon Special input. The first mode fires a highly lethal projectile applying a large amount of Chem Toxin stacks to a single target, while the second firing mode spreads Chem Toxin in a small radius, but also injects the enemy hit by the projectile with a delayed toxin. Enemies injected with the delayed toxin will explode on death, dealing significant damage in a small area.

These firing modes allow the Needle Pistol to be very versatile and function well in multiple situations, switching between dealing with single targets or larger groups of enemies with ease.

Shivs

We wanted to display not just the brutal nature but also the craftiness of the Hive Scum, and few things show that better than the shivs! While they may look like crude pieces of metal, the Hive Scum are intimately familiar with how to make their enemies bleed with them, and many are quite fond of their personal pair.

They’re extremely fast dual wielded melee weapons that attack from various angles, and while the base damage is somewhat low, they deal devastating blows when targeting weak spots and have the mobility to let you easily avoid attacks and even position to backstab any enemy.

These come with two Marks, one focused more on stabbing and the other on slashing.

candidates.title: Hive Scum class - Out Now!
candidates.text:
There will also be plenty of options to create your unique Hive Scum; new faces, tattoos, hairstyles and even (for the first time) face paints that will let you customize them to your heart's content.

[img src=" lab and Cartel Special

The Hive Scum is more than just a pretty face. All those years in the hive have granted the scum enough chemical know-how to brew their very own Stimms. Upon reaching level 5, you will gain access to the Stimm Lab, a new separate talent tree that lets you customize your Cartel Special, a personalized Stimm for use in the field.

Spending points in the Stimm Lab will add buffs to your Cartel Special (of increasing effectiveness) that activate upon use during missions. Unlike other Stimms, the Cartel Special runs off a cooldown timer, meaning that you will be able to use it multiple times throughout the mission.

The amount of effects you can add is dependent on the Volume of your Stimm, which increases as you level up. As more and more powerful effects are crammed in, your cooldown will begin to climb. There will be a balance here to find for your particular build.

Cycling Stimm use regularly is a core part of playing Hive Scum, but if you prefer to play without it, emptying your Cartel Special will automatically unequip it, letting you use street Stimms in missions as per usual.

Cooldown: between 15 to 75 seconds, depending on points used.

[img src="

Talent Tree

As the scum of the hive, your playstyle is going to work a little bit different to what you might be used to. The Hive Scum is volatile and comparably squishy to its peers, but with great payoffs in damage, toxin spread and customisability. As usual, the talent tree can be viewed as three sections of a whole, shaping your troublemaker to your liking.

candidates.title: Forza Motorsport Introduces Road Atlanta and Multi-Class Racing
candidates.text:
Founded in 1969, this track has held many championships and formats that range from endurance racing to amateur challenges. Events currently hosted on this American classic include the Michelin Pilot Challenge, IMSA SportsCar Championship, and Formula D. Its full layout includes 12 turns and unique sections like the "esses" between turns 3 and 5, and the downhill turn 12.

Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta features a 2.54-mile Full Circuit with 12 turns and a 1.77-mile Club Circuit with 9 turns. Challenge both layouts in Time Attack and use your favorite tuned cars to rise in the global leaderboards, or race on them in Career and Featured Multiplayer, or host your own events on Road Atlanta in Free Play and Private Multiplayer.

Our next track release is scheduled for Update 13, which we expect to be available in mid-October.

Experience the Road to Race Tour

In Career Mode, dive into the world of road cars and their racecar variants.

Experience Chevrolet Corvette, Ferrari 458 Italia, Lamborghini Huracán, and Porsche 911 GT3 in the Road to Race Tour. See firsthand all the differences between these incredible machines as you drive in the road version of these cars followed by their racing counterparts.

Series 1: Road – 2015 Chevrolet Corvette Z06

The 2015 Chevrolet Corvette Z06's racing DNA is as visible on its aerodynamic outside as it is on its powerful inside.

Powered by a 6.2-liter V8 engine, this car sure knows how to leave its mark on the road and on the track.
Enjoy driving the Z06 for the first Road Series on the Road to Race Tour!

Series 1: Race – 2014 Chevrolet #3 Corvette Racing Corvette C7.R

It’s time to leave the road behind and enter the track on the next series of the Road to Race Tour, driving the racing version of the Z06: an endurance racing powerhouse built by the all-star team up of Corvette and Pratt Miller.

candidates.text:
Its fresh take on Career, Season Play introduced a calendar inspired structure with championship weekends.

There was also a first-person car camera, drifting and drag racing, new driving assists like Rewind, customizable multiplayer rulesets, and players could paint and upgrade every car in the game.

With almost 500 cars to collect – as well as 25 tracks and 138 layouts – it was the biggest Forza game of its time!

Forza Motorsport 3 also has one of the most beloved Forza trailers ever, featuring the community legends at Team Blackjack tandem drifting at Fujimi Kaido!

Cover Car: 2010 Audi R8 5.2 FSI quattro

[img src=" 2010 Audi R8 5.2 FSI quattro was your invitation to speed in Forza Motorsport 3.

Under the Audi R8’s glass engine cover is the Lamborghini Gallardo LP560-4’s incredible V10, nestled in the middle of a highly advanced aluminum monocoque.

The R8 5.2 FSI quattro is an all-wheel drive supercar of class and comfort: a larger engine with increased performance (525 bhp) over its predecessor, with alluringly athletic sheet metal that draws comparisons with its competitors from Stuttgart.

Forza Motorsport 4

ENDANGERED SPECIES

Celebrated as a favorite amongst many Forza enthusiasts in our community, Forza Motorsport 4 introduced new social and online features to connect our players.

It was the last Motorsport game released on Xbox 360. Career mode features the World Tour – a racing calendar spanning 10 years – the Event List and Rivals. Meanwhile, Multiplayer features included Clubs and shared garages, custom public lobbies, Storefronts, and car soccer.

candidates.text:
Tracks haven’t seen an ankle-breaker like this one. To celebrate our partnership with Jordan in Forza Motorsport, we’re sending all players a car inspired by the iconic sneaker, the custom 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3 Motorsport Edition. Simply play Forza Motorsport before January 31, 2025, to claim the car for free. It’s all gas. And brakes!

In addition to the car, players can enter the Jordan Luka 3 Motorsport Series, which will be available in the Career mode until January 31, 2025. Take the 1969 Chevrolet Camaro Jordan Luka 3 Motorsport Edition through five tracks including Silverstone, Catalunya, Yas Marina, and a special rendition of Hakone featuring the iconic Jordan brand. Reach Unexpected Speed and complete all 5 events to win a unique Jordan Luka 3 Racing Suit that you can wear in the game.

Race Exceptional Cars in the Mid-Engine Tour

Mid-engine sports cars are renowned for their exceptional balance, achieved by placing the engine near the vehicle's center for better weight distribution and a lower center of gravity. This layout allows for larger, more powerful engines without sacrificing handling or performance. However, due to cost, design complexity, and limited cabin and storage space, this configuration does not lend itself to everyday vehicles. Mid-engine cars are special, as they are as good at turning heads as they are at turning laps.

The Mid-Engine Tour invites you on a journey to discover some of the most popular mid-engine sports cars in four racing series: Mid-Engine Muscles, Mid-Engine Legends, Mid-Engine Monsters, and Mid-Engine Miracles.

Mid-Engine Muscles

Experience modern-day Mid-Engine Muscles like the twin-turbocharged 2019 Ferrari F8 Tributo with its best-in-class performance in the first series of the Mid-Engine Tour.

candidates.text:
The naturally aspirated 5.5-liter V8 fitted in the C7.R has propelled it to win more than one Teams’, Constructors’, and Drivers’ Championships and an impressive #1 position at the 2015 big race.

Series 2: Road – 2009 Ferrari 458 Italia

The 2009 Ferrari 458 Italia is a convergence of power, aesthetics, and engineering.

Not only designed to look beautiful while you drive it on the road or the track, the 458’s exterior was also built to maximize aerodynamics and downforce.
Sitting in the middle of the car is what completes its awesome core: a 4.8-Liter Ferrari V8 engine that allows the 458 to reach 325 km/h top speed and go from 0-100 in 3.4 seconds.

Series 2: Race – 2011 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione F458 Italia GTC

One of Ferrari's most successful racing cars enters the spotlight in the Road to Race Tour.

With an overall lighter body and improved downforce, the 2011 Ferrari #62 Risi Competizione 458 Italia GTC scored 15 Team Championships and over 100 race wins.
Mounted in the middle of the car, the GTC's V8 engine produces 500 horsepower. Take it to the limit on the Road to Race Tour!

Series 3: Road – 2014 Lamborghini Huracán LP 610-4

Putting the best of Lamborghini's flashy style and the best racing engineering, the bull brand came up with a striking hypercar, the 2014 Lamborghini Huracán LP 610-4.

From every angle, the LP-610 looks as you would expect a Lambo to look like; to reach the real substance of the car, you need to dig deeper into its hood to find the mighty V10 engine that powers a four-wheel drive system.
600 horsepower to tame both roads and tracks are at your disposal on the Road to Race Tour during its penultimate week.

candidates.title: Forza Motorsport Introduces Road Atlanta and Multi-Class Racing
candidates.text:
Series 3: Race – 2015 Lamborghini #63 Squadra Corse Huracán LP620-2 Super Trofeo
To ramp up the antics on their already over-the-top Huracán LP610-4, Lamborghini gave the keys to their motorsport department, Squadra Corse, and created an endurance racer branded with the Raging Bull.
This extra powerful Huracán comes with a 5.2-liter V10 engine capable of putting out 612 bhp into the car's rear-wheel drive system.
Complementing the traditionally flamboyant body we are used to seeing from the brand, the Super Trofeo includes a rear wing and front bumpers that increase downforce and grip.
Put the racing twin brother of the Lamborghini Huracán to the track test in the Road to Race Tour.

Series 4: Road – 2019 Porsche 911 GT3 RS

Given the rear wing and striking engine, it might be a surprising contender, but the 2019 Porsche 911 GT3 RS is the final road car for the Road to Race Tour.

The GT3 RS is a track-focused version of the 911 we can all recognize from a mile away. You can see evidence of this design philosophy in its flat-six engine that puts out 500 horsepower and the suspension that gives this car supreme grip.
Drive the car that blurs the line between road and race with the Porsche 911 GT3 RS.

Series 4: Race – 2018 Porsche #73 Park Place Motorsports 911 GT3 R

Although the 2018 Porsche 911 #73 Park Place Motorsports 911 GT3 RS produces as much power as its road-focused version, this car's body and engine modifications give the extra kick the GT3 RS needs to be called a proper racer.

A conqueror of multiple tracks, this car has competed in several GT races and earned big wins at many of those events, including Petit Le Mans – a sportscar endurance race hosted annually at Road Atlanta.
Close out the Road to Race Tour on a banger with the ultimate 911 racer.

candidates.title: Launch Feedback & Next Steps
candidates.text:
Dear players,

Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown has been available to all players since September 12 on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S. If you haven’t seen it yet, we invite you to check out the launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=j9zL-tKG2Io;full][/previewyoutube]
This launch is the culmination of over six years of development by a little over 90 developers, animators, designers, artists, and many others. Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown is a project particularly close to our teams' hearts. It is now time to revisit most of the topics raised by the community with you, while also sharing information on the next stages of development.

Servers

As you know, September 5 marked the start of Early Unlock for Gold Edition owners. Beyond this Early Unlock, players also got to discover 6 exceptional cars in their garage, 3 exclusive sticker packs, and 3 unique legendary outfits.

However, the Early Unlock launch did not go as we had hoped. Many of you experienced connection and/or game access issues. From day one, we focused all our efforts on improving the game services to allow most players to enjoy the long-awaited Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown experience.

As mentioned in our previous official communication regarding the server issues, we continue every day to work tirelessly to resolve these problems once and for all. Today, although the majority of issues have been resolved, there are still persistent cases in certain regions/platforms, including an issue related to saves, which is currently being fixed. Several reasons explain this:

- Every day since September 5, new milestones of simultaneous players have been reached. This pushes the servers and the game’s databases to face new technical challenges, leading to unprecedented network issues. Although the previous playtest and beta phases helped us anticipate and prevent many imbalances for the launch, some technical scenarios could only be discovered with the player volume present at launch.

candidates.title: Solar Club Letter #5 - The Driving Experience
candidates.text:
Dear Solar Club members,

As you saw in our last video, The Cruiser, the driving experience - and not just for racing - is key to our approach to Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown. Lots of Test Drive Unlimited fans still remember the first time they got behind the wheel of the car of their dreams in the previous version, whether they were going for a spin in town or meeting up with friends on the streets of Ibiza or Oahu in TDU and TDU 2. One of our objectives is to give you the same sensations with Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown, on the streets of Hong Kong Island. In this latest Solar Club Newsletter, we take a look at how the driving experience will be shifting up a gear in TDUSC.

EACH CAR HAS ITS OWN PHYSICS.

Car physics is a critical aspect of development. For some people, TDU2 did not meet all of its objectives in this respect: they felt the physics were too arcade-like, even unpredictable. As you already know, TDUSC integrates different car categories, from Classics to the Hypercar, Off-roads to Supercars, the Citroën 2CV to the Bugatti Chiron Sport.

candidates.text: hello no. i dont know what exactly happen with the physcis of the game but now its worse than it was before. one curb can sent u flying for no reason ruinning a whole run. the handbrake is broken, not in a good way. the shifts are messed up. the cars slide in tarmac like you are playing in snow. its freaking terrible. i thought WRC 10 was bad but this one is on another level.

candidates.title: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship review
candidates.text: WRC 10 looks a lot like the previous edition, the graphics a little better but the differences are almost unnoticed.The driving experience and physics feels with a better sense of car mass and weight transfer, on gravel it's ok but on asphalt i miss the physics of the WRC 8 which was excellent, it's a game that easily adapts to driving with a gamepad or with steering wheel.New rallies, Croatia Japan and Estonia, are back Chile and Spain, as they are not part of the calendar New Zealand and Australia are not available, also noticed some removed stages such as Fafe Portugal which is strange since they added a shakedown with the track completely overhauled and more real they've never done before!Cars, lots of news here the usual Porshe 911 Vw Polo WRC and Proton Iriz Rally 2 now we have more variety in an edition called anniversary, where we can participate in some iconic and new rallies stages in Greece or San Remo, such as Alpine A110, Lancia Stratos and 037 RWD, Audi quattro A1, Peugeot 205 T16, Delta HF, Toyota Corolla and Celica GT4, Subaru Impreza WRC 1997, Lancer Evo V and Citroen Xsara and DS3 by Solberg WRT.The sound of the engines and exhaust still needs more dedication.Career mode is still very good even better than its main rival and we now have the anniversary mode which is also very satisfying!The game is essentially identical to the previous edition with some new content, it's a good level title the amazing stage design and the satisfying handling model make it easy and enjoyable.

candidates.title: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship review
candidates.text: While not a bad game, this really is a step down from WRC 9, not sure why but here the cars feel a bit "floaty", also the sound I thought WRC 9 sounded better. Performance wise, what happened? It's a bit choppy at times with a RTX card. Can't give this game a negative because it still is a good game, but if anyone asked, I'd go for 9 instead, we'll see what KT do for their last licensed WRC game in 2022, hopefully a final step in the right direction.

candidates.game: WRC Generations – The FIA WRC Official Game
candidates.title: WRC Generations – The FIA WRC Official Game review
candidates.text: In essence, this game is almost the same as WRC 10 with some extra polish and the new generation Rally1 vehicles. There are some aspects however that are downgraded compared to the predecessor:- The car sounds in WRC10 were bad, this game is somehow even worse, some cars even have bugged audio- The infamous throttle input bug in 1st gear - No 50th anniversary mode, I was hoping they could include a similar mode with a selection of historic moments and the relevant information and footage. - Rain is not simulated properly, as far as I can see there really is no point in running wets over softs- Something is up with the handbrake which makes everyone spin out- The gearing is simply not correct in some cars (some cars have 5 gears while their IRL counterparts have 6)- Center diffs in Rally1 while they are banned IRL

candidates.title: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship review
candidates.text: Having played many other rally games prior to this, and especially WRC8 a game I really enjoyed. WRC10 takes everything from that game and makes it better, more vehicle variety brings a fresh feel to the game, physics and visuals are improved and game runs smooth on my system with steamplay/proton on linux.My hardware specs are the following; ryzen 3700x, gtx 1070ti, 32gb 3600mt ram

candidates.title: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship review
candidates.text: Here's what I like about this game- Very realistic handling physics, quite similar with DiRT Rally- WRC 50th Anniversary that includes classic rally cars- Livery editor allows you to create your own custom livery for your rally cars- Changeable of your rally co-drivers gender in career mode- Tire choices- New rallies as per 2021 FIA World Rally Championship season calendarHere's what I feel 'Neutral' about this game (average)- Engine sounds are good, but can done it better- Career mode is just like the same as previous WRC entries, but it has been slightly modified- Graphics are quite okay enough, could have done better- Stages are pretty fine but I think some stages are almost exactly the same as WRC 9Here's what I don't like about this game- Crash and damage physics isn't realistic enoughMy verdict of this game: It is one of the best WRC games I've ever played and WRC 10 is the last 2021 World Rally Championship video game that features the 2021 World Rally Cars before next year's WRC season with Rally1 cars. I would recommend it for any FIA World Rally Championship fan out there.

candidates.game: WRC Generations – The FIA WRC Official Game
candidates.title: WRC Generations – The FIA WRC Official Game review
candidates.text: Love this game! Only problem is the car tuning. It is one of the more realistic WRC games but yet the tuning of the cars is so generic. It talks about + or - but its on 0 - 10, for instance center diff doesn't tell you front or rear bias just 30 - 85 or something but to what? Camber settings are 0-10 not in degrees.... If they would put some time into the tune-ability of cars better this would be best hands down.

candidates.title: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship review
candidates.text: I don't know what the fuss about Dirt 2.0 being better than this game is all about. I like Dirt 2.0 but in WRC 10 the cars actually drive like small, nimble, high performace cars instead of everything feeling like a Ford F-350 pickup in Dirt 2.0. That and when you consider the rally tracks are better in detail, longer and there's way more stages than Dirt 2.0 and I think I have to recommend WRC 10! There is the odd graphic stutter which I am not sure if it is the settings I am running but its a good looking game, career mode is light years ahead of Dirt 2.0 with so many options to manage. If you like WRC this is the game for sure.

candidates.title: New Trailer - The Croatia Rally makes its debut in WRC 10!
candidates.text:
Hello WRC fans!

We are pleased to unveil some new gameplay images for WRC 10, the official video game of the FIA World Rally Championship, which releases this September.

[previewyoutube=IZRsDoXbA0c;full][/previewyoutube]

As we celebrate the Croatia Rally's very first appearance in the Championship calendar, it may already be regarded as one of the most exciting events in WRC history. Contested a few weeks ago, a WRC asphalt rally has never been so close with just six tenths of a second separating the winner, Sébastien Ogier, from Welshman Elfyn Evans.

And now these breathtaking performances can be recreated by virtual drivers in September in WRC 10. The Croatia Rally takes place entirely on asphalt on very varied surfaces that are often rutted and damaged from the region's bad weather. These roads in the heart of the Croatian countryside are often extremely narrow and require immaculate handling to maintain speed. Thanks to the ultra-realistic physics developed by KT Racing, WRC 10 offers a unique driving experience in 4K and 60FPS that closely matches what real drivers feel. Follow in the tracks of the greatest drivers and become the next legend with WRC 10!

With WRC 10, the leading off-road racing simulator is reinventing itself once more! Finish the 2021 season atop the podium and relive the most intense moments at the wheel of iconic cars to celebrate 50 years of the competition.

- 6 historic rallies, including Acropolis, San Remo, Germany, Argentina…
- Over 20 legendary cars, including Alpine, Audi, Lancia, Subaru, Ford, Mitsubishi, Toyota…
- All 4 new rallies added to the 2021 calendar: Estonia, Croatia, Belgium and Spain
- 52 official teams of the 2021 season (WRC, WRC2, WRC3, Junior WRC)

WRC 10 will be available on 2 September 2021 on Steam.

candidates.title: WRC 9 FIA World Rally Championship review
candidates.text: I'm going to be comparing this to the codemasters Dirt Rally 2.0 game. This also applies to WRC 10 because the developers just seem to be re releasing at this point.Firstly the most important thing: the driving feel. Wrc does this well for the most part. It feels on par with DR2 until you drive any car besides the official FIA cars. Whe you jump in to a historic car you can't help but feel like you've jumped in to a different game with far inferior physics. Thia had been the same for all recent WRC games and I don't see it changing. In DR2 however it feels the same level of care and attention was put across all cars offered which is also incidentally a far superior selection then that offered to you by WRC titles. One thing that people familiar with both titles may point out is the tarmac physics. To me they feel wanting in both games. They both feel floaty and weird where as in my opinion DR2 feels far more responsive on any surface.Nextly: the stages. This is where in my opinion WRC is undeniably the better of the two. The stages in WRC are captivating and exciting. With the exception of some notable stages in DR2, such as the ones featured in new england, they all feel somewhat samey compared to the WRC titles.The last comparison I'll make is on career modes which is a difficult choice. I feel that DR2 gives more playability with the rallycross career. However the WRC career is exceedingly more immersive. It does come down to what works best for you however.I see the superior career mode in DR2 dude to the ability to save up for mew and faster cars, entering rally events with something different each time while also upgrading your team. This is an experience not avaliable in WRC. What is presented is an experience more a kin to the F1 series.

candidates.title: WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship review
candidates.text: Videótesztem a játékról: Az eddigi legkompaktabb WRC rész, ami főleg az új Dirt Rallyra váróknak lehet megfelelő alternatíva. A sorozat rajongóinak nincs túl sok szembetűnő változás, a karrier mód kb. koppra ugyanolyan mint a 9-ben. Viszont a sok apró előrelépés a hangban, grafikában, fizikában, mindenképp a WRC előnyére vált, ami egyértelműen most a legjobb. Az Anniversary mód méltó tisztelgés a nagyok előtt, jó látni, hogy végre a legendás '90-es évek Toyotái is bekerültek a választékba, az Audi Quattro pedig számomra magasan a legjobban sikerült autó lett a felhozatalból. A pályák egyre szebbek és ingerdúsabbak, rengeteg a technikás (monte carlo, új zéland) és a begyakorlásra is megfelelő (pl. horvát) szakaszok.Egyelőre még mindig másodhegedűs ralli játék a WRC 10, de újabb lépést tett előre annak érdekében, hogy a jövőben trónbitorlóvá léphessen elő a Dirt Rally széria ellenében.

candidates.title: WRC 10 is available now !
candidates.text:
Hey everyone!

Today we are thrilled to announce that WRC 10 is now available to download on Steam, watch now the Launch Trailer for the game!

[previewyoutube=hKDh3RyVahk;full][/previewyoutube]
To celebrate 50 years of the competition in 2022, WRC 10 offers a unique anniversary edition, bursting with new features and driving thrills. A retrospective mode offers you the chance to relive 19 events that have shaped the history of the Championship. These challenging special stages put drivers' skills to the test by imposing conditions specific to each era. Drive six historic rallies, including the legendary Acropolis Rally (Greece) and Rallye Sanremo (Italy), with over 20 of the WRC's most iconic cars: Alpine, Audi, Lancia, Subaru, Ford, Mitsubishi, Toyota… With more content than ever, you will love WRC 10 and its homage to 50 years of rallying.

The physics, which have already been praised by critics and drivers in WRC 9, have been further improved to offer you an even more realistic experience. Control of aerodynamic forces, the turbo and braking have received particular attention on all surfaces, so that WRC 10 recreates ever more accurate and intense driving sensations. Immersion has also been increased with a completely reworked audio design for this new edition. Experience rallying as if you are there!

The hugely popular Career mode has also been improved with a new livery editor and the chance to create your own team. You can now apply your own colours to championship cars to complement the 52 official teams of the 2021 season. Take up the challenge with your own custom team!

candidates.title: WRC 10 - Available September 2, 2021!
candidates.text:
Hello drivers!

We're extremely thrilled today to announce that WRC 10, the official video game of the FIA World Rally Championship will be available on September 2, 2021 on Steam!

[previewyoutube=jZLyseyp9dQ;full][/previewyoutube]

50 years of rallying!

To celebrate 50 years of the competition, WRC 10 offers a unique anniversary edition, bursting with new features and driving thrills. A Retrospective Mode offers players the chance to relive 19 events that have shaped the history of the Championship. These challenging special stages put drivers' skills to the test by imposing conditions specific to each era.

- 6 historic rallies, including Acropolis, San Remo, Germany, Argentina…
- Over 20 legendary cars, including Alpine, Audi, Lancia, Subaru, Ford, Mitsubishi, Toyota…
- All 4 new rallies added to the 2021 calendar: Estonia, Croatia, Belgium and Spain
- 52 official teams of the 2021 season (WRC, WRC2, WRC3, Junior WRC)

Even more immersive!

The physics, which have already been praised by critics and drivers in WRC 9, have been further improved to offer players an even more realistic experience. Control of aerodynamic forces, the turbo and braking have received particular attention on all surfaces, so that WRC 10 recreates ever more accurate and intense driving sensations. Immersion has also been increased with a completely reworked audio design for this new edition. Experience rallying as if you are there!

Create your own team!

The hugely popular Career Mode has also been improved with a new livery editor and the chance to create your own team. You can now apply your own colours to championship cars to complement the 52 official teams of the 2021 season. Take up the challenge with your own custom team!

WRC 10 will be available on Steam on September 2, 2021. Be sure to wishlist WRC 10 FIA World Rally Championship to get notified with all the latest news of the game!

candidates.title: RIDE 5 review
candidates.text: I am not sure what people are on about. The game feels different to ride 4, but that's a GOOD thing. It feels much better. Those complaining about braking don't understand how brakes work on a motorcycle, and in Ride 5 they work so much better than 4 if you understand how physics work. If you don't manage your weight transfer correctly, bike isn't going to brake correctly. Content is a lot of carry over yes, but that's how racing games work for the most part (look at forza...) they've got some new bikes as well, and most DLC content from the previous game, I'm excited to see what more gets added. But so far the complains that originally had me hold off on buying this game are silly, it feels miles ahead of Ride 4 as far as realism. But it does have a steeper learning curve to get the hang of it.

candidates.title: Frequently Asked Questions
candidates.text:
Certain ships, such as the Reliat - Stealth Frigate have weapons that attack ship system, or enhancements that allow one or more of their weapons to attack ship systems, usually the main weapon. If a system is destroyed then it will obviously stop working.

System damage is not repaired by "healers" (repair UAVs) but it is instantly and completely repaired once the fleet has a break of combat - any period of time, no matter how brief, when it is not fighting another fleet. So, for example, a fleet that has been attacked by two enemy fleets, both enemy fleets must be defeated or retreat or the player's fleet must retreat, in order to get the "break of combat" needed for damaged systems to be repaired.

candidates.title: Solar Club Letter: May 2026
candidates.text:
That said, we can confirm we are now officially working on a plan on what offline means to Test Drive Unlimited Solar Crown, and how we will implement it. We of course wish to make sure TDUSC is playable for all players when we no longer update the game, but this is a complicated feature to work on, as all of the game is connected to the servers.

What’s Next

Working on a plan is the first step to know what will be offline, and how it will work when it’s offline. The word ‘offline’ may have a different meaning to many. Some see it as just being able to play a game without the internet. However, the truth is that it actually means being able to play a game without servers. What does this mean? Well TDUSC has a lot of features that rely on the games servers. Races, the Casino, Missions, and then there’s live service elements such as Hot Heads, Clan Challenges, and even the cars rotating in the Solar Hotel. The most important being how content in the online store can be available, Diamonds, and even how your saves can be adapted to the new system.

We want to make sure that nearly every feature of the game is still playable without the games servers, which might mean some features will have to be changed to work with this new system (for example if we want poker to be playable without servers).

We won’t have any news to provide on the progress of our next steps for quite a few months as we are currently working on other things related to the games network and servers such as cross region, servers ‘v2’, Official Racing Center, and all of the amazing social features Season 8’s houses will bring, but we want to ask you a question, what does offline mean to you? What should be available? What do you think should be a priority in what offline can offer? Leave your feedback to us on our Discord and social media outlets, we’ll be reading it all!

💌 A Message To The Community

name: Repair Tool
kit: , ,
cost: 60 (Support)
slot: Gadget/Special ability
feature: Allows operator to repair own vehicle internally
level: Default (Tanker, Pilot)
damage: 50 (80 headshot)

The Handyman

The Repair Tool is used by the Tanker, Pilot, and Support classes.

As before, the repair tool allows players to repair friendly vehicles from outside, inflict damage to enemy vehicles, repair map placements, and attack enemy soldiers. Multiple players can repair the same vehicle more quickly, but at a reduced individual rate.

The repair tool grants tankers and pilots the ability to repair the vehicle they are operating from within, reminiscent of the wrench's function in Battlefield Heroes. Armor is regained in 20 point increments every five seconds for heavy armored ground vehicles, and in 25 point increments for air vehicles.

During internal repair, the vehicle cannot be operated by the player, leaving tracked ground vehicles stationary and air vehicles gliding. Wheeled vehicles may be driven forward or backward, but cannot be steered. Internal repair can be cancelled by enemy fire, or by the player performing any other action. Other vehicle occupants can continue to use other seats as normal. Internal repairs are much slower but sometimes safer to perform, while external repairs allow the operator of the tank to continue to move and fire, at greater personal risk to the repairer. External repairs increase vehicle health in smaller increments at much smaller intervals, and unlike internal repairs, external repairs are not interrupted when the vehicle takes damage. Supports repairing a vehicle in the middle of combat can effectively make the vehicles last much longer, particularly if the tank is providing them cover with smoke and/or health. A single assault player attacking an unsupported vehicle can be a serious threat to it, but a support player can repair most damage an assault can do almost as quickly as the vehicle takes damage.

What's up!

Update 4 is now finally available on Early Access! This update is jam-packed with new content! So let me break it down for y'all!

If you're looking for the complete patch notes of the update then scroll to the bottom of the post!

https://i.imgur.com/q5YKhs8.png

Drones

Transporting things on conveyor belts is cool and all - but transporting things using drones is indisputably better, so we added that. Still, they wouldn’t let me stand on them though on account that it could interfere with the drone’s avionics. I don’t blame ‘em.

Drones are designed for long-range, low-capacity transportation and unlocks in tier 7 & 8. The drones are fully automated, traveling between two fixed ports and navigating themselves around any obstacles they encounter along the way.

Each port can only contain one drone but they move across the map extremely quickly and are far easier to set up than Trains, Belts, or Trucks. Drones require batteries as fuel and their consumption rate and travel speed become more efficient as delivery distances increase. They can’t carry much, but they’re doing their best.

https://i.imgur.com/nluYGSz.png

Hover pack and Ziplines

But drones aren’t the only thing flying around! There’s new equipment pioneers from FICSIT Inc. can also utilize such as the brand-new hover pack to get a good overview of their production lines and build from a higher vantage point! Hover packs draws power from the power grid and doesn’t require any extra fuel to function. However, they’re not the fastest way to get around and explore with, but not everything’s a competition.

candidates.title: Drone
candidates.text:
Each Drone can only be assigned to 1 home Drone Port, and that home Drone Port can only be linked to 1 other Drone Port (that Drone Port, in turn, doesn't necessarily need to be linked back to this Drone Port). There is no limitation on the numbers of assigned Drones unloading on a Drone Port, however one must be queued until the other fully unloads. Waiting Drones will circle above the Drone Port.

When flying from one Port to another, a Drone will show a take-off animation, wiggling around; rise vertically, turning mid-air then fly roughly in a straight line to the destination. It then descends, followed by some wiggling animation and finally docks. Drones will attempt to navigate around obstacles mid-flight. As the take-off and landing animation can be a considerable amount of time, the efficiency of Drones increases with distance.

A Drone consumes a minimum of 4 Batteries per trip plus 1 Battery per km of flight distance.

Drones are potentially the 2nd fastest mean of transportation, second to the Hyper Tube cannon. Pioneers can stand on the Drone for a ride, however, a fall protection equipment such as a Jetpack is highly recommended as the Drone will push away the pioneer mid-air when it starts accelerating forward.

candidates.title: The First Descendant review
candidates.text: 現在マスタリーランク17まで進行しました。 最初に言いますが無課金で全キャラ及び武器の入手は出来ますが果てしない時間と労力がかかる為、お勧めできません。 運が良ければ20時間前後、悪ければ私のように30時間かけても作れません。 前提としてキャラ及びアルティメットの武器を作成するには3つのパーツの図面と設計図が1つ必要です。 パーツなどを入手するには、宝箱を20%の確率でドロップするクエストを延々と周り入手→宝箱の種類によっては宝箱を開けるために別の素材を入手→ボス戦→宝箱開封→宝箱の中身は5種類ありどれが出るかはランダム(偏りあり)→欲しいものではなかったら最初に戻る→欲しいものが出たら入手が大変な大量の素材と図面を消費してクラフト(設計図はクラフトする必要なし)これでやっと１パーツ完成です。 あるキャラを作成しようとファームを始めて30時間ほど経過しましたがやっと図面が３つ揃いました。 この後設計図入手と素材集めがあると考えた途端に冷めました。 キャラや武器の育成要素にモジュール(Warframeで言うMOD)があります。 サービス開始したばかりなので仕方ない面もありますが有用なものが少ないです。 そのせいでダメージが伸び悩み、ストーリークリア後のハードモードのダンジョンがかなりきつく、ストレスしか溜まりません。 (なぜかハードのダンジョンはマッチメイキングが無くソロorフレンド等を誘って事前にPTを組む必要あり)ではハードに行かなければいいじゃないとお思いかもしれませんが、ノーマルの宝箱だと3%しか出る確率のない図面が、ハードの宝箱だと20%になったりするので行くしかありません。

candidates.title: (Updated) 5.21 (Thu) Amorphous Material Overhaul Advanced Info
candidates.text:
# PDT 2026.05.15 (Fri) 03:00 – The example content for Archive Shard has been revised to be easier to understand.

Greetings, Descendants!

To ease the Research and item farming burden for New Descendants, after the 5.21 (Thu) Update 1.3.28,

an Amorphous Material overhaul will take place.

Previously, opening an Amorphous Material would allow the acquisition of 1 of several Research Materials,

but after the update, the structures will be improved to allow the acquisition of 1 of the key materials required for a specific Descendant, Fellow, or Equipment Research.

This will allow Descendant and Equipment Research to be more easily and quickly progressed.

As a result, after the 5.21 (Thu) update, only the overhauled new Amorphous Materials can be acquired,

and existing Amorphous Materials will no longer be acquirable, so please keep this in mind.

Additionally, alongside this improvement, a new item called an "Archive Shard" will be added to enhance accessibility for Descendant and Equipment Research.

The "Archive Shard" is an item that can be acquired by playing content at Infiltration Operation Hard Difficulty or above,

and it can be used as a substitute for the Crafting Materials required to Research some Descendants and Ultimate Weapons.

This will make it easier to craft Descendants and Ultimate Weapons.

Additionally, the "Archive Shard" can also be used as a substitute for Weapon and Reactor Enhancement Materials.

■ Amorphous Material Overhaul Details

- Existing Amorphous Materials: Acquire 1 of several Research Materials

- Overhauled Amorphous Materials: Acquire 1 Code, Spiral Catalyst, Stabilizer, or Enhanced Cells required for a specific Descendant, Equipment, or Fellow Research

candidates.title: Amorphous Materials
candidates.text:
However, these materials are useless by themselves, they require a Reconstructed Device , these are blue sphere-like mechanisms that appear after defeating a Colossi or Void Reactor Boss. It should be noted that each amorphous material has its own designated Reconstructed Device to be opened with, and that these Reconstructed Devices can only be used once per spawn.
Meaning for example:

If you use 1 Amorphous material at a Colossi, you cannot break down any more materials using that Reconstructed Device, You will need to defeat the Colossi again to break down another material.

Once the material has been broken down in a Reconstructed Device, you will receive an item from the drop-table of said item. If hovered over, the tooltip of said item will display the loot table, and it's % chances. Usually containing 5 rewards with the highest chance reward being around 35% and the rarest reward at a minor 2% chance rate.

candidates.text: This game is honestly a well made fan game from start to finish. I enjoy the difficulty of each level and love solving each character's tastes in food.

candidates.title: Touhou Mystia's Izakaya review
candidates.text: This is a game that soothes your soul.Let's face it. Life is hard, it's often taxing and full of negativity, and you look around and realise it's about to get worse. But when you're lost in a sea of anger and disappointement, it's often the small sweet games that make you feel better. And this is what Mystia's Izakaya is. Part restaurant management, part simple rythm minigame, with the Touhou characters you probably all know and love by now, all made even cuter by the amazing artstyle of this game, with peaceful soundtracks which are mixes of multiple Touhou classic, all serve by a very wholesome story about the value of hard work, human contact, and chasing your dream. Mystia's Izakaya isn't a hard game, in fact even the rythm minigame which used to be hard and not in synch when I got the game, was fixed to be made VERY generous. It is a sweet and soothing game filled with humor.I recommend it because it is the game you may want to play when you don't want to play the others games. When you are tired of the guns, the complex strategies, the violence and the stress.Sometimes, you just need to treat yourself with some nice food, and listen to the song of the sparrows.

candidates.text:

youtube:https://youtu.be/TsakQEXRZA0

Touhou Mystia's Izakaya: The Animation is an animated adaptation of the izakaya simulation Touhou fangame by the circle Dichromatic Purpilion, Touhou Mystia's Izakaya.

This production of this animation was wholly realized by a team of fans, including the script, storyboard, illustration, music, sound effects and voice acting. Everything was done by fans; there are no commercial interests or commercial voice actors involved. It is purely a work by fans.

The animation will release with subtitles in 4 languages: Simplified/Traditional Chinese, Japanese, English and Korean. The same as the game.

While I am the developer of Touhou Mystia's Izakaya, I myself am a fan of this game as well. This animation will be made from the shoes of a fan, for the fans.

We plan to release the animation in episodes of around 10 minutes each, with the story being focused on parts of the game that are either lacking in description or parts I personally want to add to, serving as a companion piece to the game. Watching the animation in tandem with the game will give the best experience.

As the costs of making an animation are quite high, we currently don't know how many episodes we'll end up making. It's possible that we'll decide on the number of episodes based on the amount of sales.

candidates.title: Touhou Mystia’s Izakaya, imposing update!
candidates.text:
- We found many places can be improved after playing it ourselves, so we will still be working on it after the final edition is published to make this game better.
- Because we suddenly decided to add new songs to the game in August, the ambience music for Scarlet Demon Mansion and Bamboo Forest of The Lost are still devoid, we will add it in the game within October. Please forgive us, it’s an improvise after all, but will definitely make the game better, please give us some time!
- We originally wanted to return the drinks straight to the shelf instead of using the recycle bin, but time wasn’t our friend… so this edition doesn’t not include this function, we’ll add it later on, so far the returning of drinks still relies on the recycle bin.
- Besides bug fixing and detail improving, we will begin development on the English and Japanese Version soon. So Touhou fans around the world, cross culture, can enjoy the charisma of this game.

Then is our update content:

- The characters, musics, incidents, stories of Scarlet Demon Mansion, Bamboo Forest of The Lost Hakugyokurou were all added
- Three intense and breathtaking Boss fights, watchout don’t be crushed by Yuyuko!
- Friend(waitress?)system is added, there are five friends who can help you business!
- Basement is finally built, it contained a phonograph, an album and a closet for different outfits!
- Of course the achievements.
- Kourindou opened for business! You can buy special materials here, more powerful and seemingly dangerous kitchen wares and CDs of different areas here!
- Many minor detail changes, please find them out with your own eyes!

After all, hope you have fun playing Touhou Mystia’s Izakaya during the National day break!

candidates.text:
The number of viable SMGs felt low, compared to the relative depth of weapons of that type. As a result, several them have had damage increases this week.

- Increased weapons damage on Bitch[/*]
- Increased weapons damage on Handsome Jackhammer[/*]
- Increased weapons damage on Devoted[/*]
- Increased weapons damage on Cloud Kill[/*]
- Increased weapons damage on Tsunami[/*]
- Increased weapons damage on Ten Gallon[/*]
- Increased melee damage bonus on Ripper[/*]

The Ripper’s melee damage bonus wasn’t providing enough incentive to execute its intended loop. We’ve buffed the damage on the melee strike.

- Increased weapon damage on Vanquisher[/*]

The base damage for the Vanquisher and its bonus damage while sliding have been buffed. Like the Ripper, its core loop wasn’t being used as the slide bonus wasn’t significant enough prior to this change.

- Increased bonus damage while sliding on Vanquisher[/*]

The Ripper and Vanquisher should be very effective now when embracing their unique loops.

Weapon Nerfs

We found that a few pieces of gear were overperforming or not working as intended, which unintentionally pushed players into builds exclusively using them. It also allowed players to bypass the intended growth of moving up the Mayhem Levels over time. By lowering these values and addressing some data, players should feel able to experiment with other pieces of gear.

Sandhawk

The Sandhawk was creating too many particle systems which we found creating issues related to performance. It also was creating too much damage relative to other sniper rifles. To combat this, we’ve made the following changes.

A few bosses have had some minor tweaks made to improve their looting experience, but we have left most of the drop rates unchanged. With the thinning of the dedicated loot pools and the removal of 21 Anointments, we decided to observe these changes first then make changes as needed in the future.

Stability

- Addressed a reported crash that could occur in splitscreen[/*]
- Reduced the number of projectiles that spawn due to damage dealt when using multiple elements on enemies and limited the number of times projectiles bounce to 4 [/*]

We have adjusted how projectiles from damage events spawn. We found spikes in stability and performance concerns when too many elemental projectiles were spawning during gameplay. This was due to some weapons spawning many more projectiles than game performance recommended. The Recursion, Carrier, Bearcat, Lead Sprinkler, and others will see the effects from this change. We will be monitoring how players will be using these weapons for any possible adjustments in the future.

candidates.text: So, this game is pretty good, but realistic mode is freaking difficult!Pros:Very detailed city builder that actually poses a challenge on the hardest difficulty. I've also build on less than 5% of the map during this time as wellCons:The tutorial does NOT prepare you properly for the realistic mode (or at least not in the first couple ones). It doesn't show you how to get started on a realistic map as there's no way to build anything until you have certain stuff in place and during the tutorials this just isn't an issue as everything auto builds for you.There's a ton of downtime in between planning stuff out and actually having it be build. The priority system feels very flimsy and I've had it happen quite often where a low priority build got all the foreign workers whilst a high priority building (with all resources for that stage ready to go) being fully ignored for 5+ minutes IRL before anything comes by.A lot of information is not being shown to you, things like how many workers are needed to sustain a business at all times, how many jobs would be available (it does show how many workers can't find a workplace but not the inverse to know how much to expand your town/city by) and a bunch of other smaller stuff. Overall:If you like city builders but want something different and with an actual challenge, definitely give this game a go! If you want something simple to play, maybe checkout a different city builder
