candidates.text: 而这些小怪兽，在游戏背景中算是外星的产物，至于是病毒呢还是外星人呢，就看玩家自己在游戏中怎么理解了，毕竟一人一思想。 不过有一点要注意，不管玩家还是其他有人口的地区，如果被红色的雾覆盖，那可就有一定的危险了，指不定什么时候就忽然搞一波入侵，毕竟这小怪兽如果拍成电影，那可就是我从雾中来咯。 游戏背景设定在2050年之后，具体多少年呢，我也没太注意，不过这事真的不赖我不用心，而是这个三方鼎立的局面实在是太过喜感。 游戏中设置的有3个不同的阵营，盼望乌托邦的平衡议会首当其冲，顶着绿油油的画面走进玩家的视野，只要和他打好关系，红雾那都不是个事，分分钟还你一个绿色的世界。 而蓝色的暴力狂新耶利哥，是一个妄想使用武力称霸天下拯救世界，装备好不好在其次，关键是人家野心大啊，动不动就要去侵略别人的避难所，你说那么多你自己被占的空地都给收回了他不香嘛？ 最后一个，基佬紫的安努门徒会，地球被感染了，他无所谓，你被攻击了，他也无所谓，啥玩意都要顺其自然，结果搞得整个会里面没一个正常人，甚至包括他们的武器都给病毒化，几乎人手一把毒枪。 好好的当个人不行嘛，自己变异也就算了，还得强迫别人也一起变异，这脑回路着实清奇。 至于想知道玩家属于什么势力？ 那么只能告诉你，咱们玩家扮演的就是个游击队哪里需要帮哪里，真的是一点点发言权都没，你能做的，只有东救火西救人，研究啥的还都是你的活，地位就像是螺丝钉，不起眼，作用不大，但就是没什么话语权。

candidates.title: Starship Troopers: Terran Command review
candidates.text: While the gameplay of the game is fine, the writing of this game is the most extreme example of disrespecting the source material that I can imagine. The source material presented us with an futuristic utipian egalitarian paradize that was suddenly attacked by an alien aggressor. It tells the story of a group of rookies that join the army to protect their world from destruction, and follows them inside the military as they rise through the ranks. It displays an extremely high trust society, where there are high expectations and accountability for political leaders, who are democratically selected by the people who were willing to put their lives on the line to protect their world. The idea of the setting was to give heroes something worth fighting for.However, the writters of the game seem to have interpreted that the setting is instead a totalitarian dictatorship with no accountability and no regard to people's lives. It is a distopian hellhole where, for some reason, the federation is casually mining a bug infested planet for an unexplained reason, and it is impossible to prevent miners from dying, so they just send wave after wave of miners inside the bug infested tunnels. When the miners revolt, they choose to make a theatrical execution of the miner's leader, in a prizon that is currently being sieged by bugs. in the end, to obtain the image of the rebel being killed, everyoe in the prizon, including the staff is sacrificed. The game then continues to display propaganda about how the federation keeps miners safe.The game is full of suicidal morons happily charging into certaind death just because they were ordered to. Even the game's mecanics implie that soldiers are just fodder, as you can send them to die over and over again with not even a loss of resources involved. Having an unit killed refunds the resource spent on it. Healing in the game is just bringing more people.

candidates.title: Subnautica: Below Zero review
candidates.text: Even though I'm giving it a thumbs down, I want to say that I love what Unknown Worlds has created with the Subnautica series, and I think they've been a great, reputable company in a time when most companies lose that reputation at the first sign of success. Thank you team.I'm giving Below Zero a thumbs down because I feel they've gone in an unproductive direction with their sequel, and have ignored some of the game mechanics that make the under water world so fun.The survival aspect of the game really quickly disappearsNone of the monsters are threatening at all, and their behavior is very poorly scripted. As soon as you solve air tanks and water, there's absolutely nothing threatening about the environment.The tech tree doesn't serve the game at all.Lots of the advanced tech is all grouped together in the sea monkey nests. In my game I found the rebreather and the oxygen tanks very quickly and basically didn't need anything else to progress through the story. The tech is tied in really poorly to game progression. Some of the additions like the charge fins and the water suit remove tedium from the game, which is eventually good, but there wasn't any new tech that added *fun* to the game.The land environment is very uninspiredI understand what they were going for adding more land to the game, but it really did not do anything good for the game. Subnautica was awesome for the rich underwater world, the land they added to below zero is just a really boring white-out.I wish they would have doubled down and added more depth to what they already had in the original subnautica. I would have liked to see harder survival in the environment (food + water is boring), I wanted to see more challenging creatures and terrain situations. There could have been additions to the fps, so you really had to fight the environment.

candidates.title: Asphodel
candidates.text:
Asphodel is a fiery, volcanic wasteland—a stark contrast in the verdant Elysium or the shadowy depths of Tartarus. It is filled with rivers of magma and crumbling terrain, creating a chaotic, treacherous landscape that reflects its in-between nature within the Underworld.

Society and Culture: Asphodel represents those who led unremarkable lives, neither heroic nor villainous, and were assigned to this realm for eternity. Its "inhabitants" are ghostly shades, wandering aimlessly, lost in a sea of fire and lava. There is a sense of desolation here, as Asphodel lacks the honor of Elysium or the torment of Tartarus—it is a realm defined by its mediocrity and perpetual stagnation.
In the context of Hades gameplay, Asphodel feels relentless and chaotic, hosting dangerous enemies like Inferno Bombers, Bone Hydras, and other fiery foes. The realm seems less concerned with culture and more with survival, embodying the challenges and unpredictable dangers faced by Zagreus as he strives to escape the Underworld.

candidates.title: The Underworld
candidates.text: The Underworld in Hades is a sprawling, labyrinthine realm divided into distinct zones, each with its own challenges and aesthetic. Starting from Tartarus, the grim prison of lost souls, players ascend through fiery Asphodel, verdant Elysium, and the mysterious Temple of Styx, each saturated with atmospheric detail. The environment reflects the mythology—dark, oppressive, but also strangely beautiful—with haunting music and colorful visuals adding depth to this realm of the dead. The inhabitants of the Underworld encompass gods, shades (souls of the deceased), monsters, and legendary figures. Central to the society is Hades himself, ruling with an iron fist, and his son Zagreus, the protagonist trying to escape. Gods like Nyx, Thanatos, and Hypnos inhabit the House of Hades, contributing their own distinct personalities to the dynamic. Shades serve as the quiet masses, often lamenting their eternal fate but occasionally offering humorous quips. The society is hierarchical, with Hades at the top and the Shades at the bottom. However, familial bonds complicate the structure—Zagreus's rebellious streak and relationships with figures like Persephone (his mother) and Achilles highlight the tension between authority and individual agency. The Underworld's culture blends traditional Greek mythology with modern twists. Olympian gods frequently interact with Zagreus via boons, showcasing their vibrant personalities and meddling nature. The themes of loyalty, rebellion, and redemption pervade the story. Art and music are integral parts of the culture—Orpheus provides haunting melodies, while the decor reflects the timelessness of the realm. Interactions between characters add a surprising layer of warmth and humor to the otherwise somber setting.

candidates.title: The Outer Worlds review
candidates.text: 然而稍有常识的人都知道，任何一个有点权力的国企，员工都比当地的大部分私企和穷老百姓更加舒服更加人上人。 ----比如剧情中设定翡翠鸟星系距离地球有漫长的航程，无论在失联前后，地球都难以顾及这片边陲殖民地，而这样的殖民地居然可以平稳运行几十年，没有从自身产生更为复杂的自发秩序团体，比如军阀、独立政府等等，掌握权力的“大公司”居然老老实实地继续生产日用品服务顾客，哪怕是保险公司也只不过通过玩弄文字游戏来拖延或者克扣保险金……这哪里是在讽刺公司，要是现实中能赶上这样的公司，简直就是绝对的良心企业。 ----比如捏他基督教会的至上法则教派，辐射系列的天启追随者并没有刻意避开关于基督教的部分，不知道为什么到了天外世界中，创作者一拍脑袋就想了一个“至上法则教”，游戏中除了队友牧师相关任务之外，根本没有体现出什么这个教派的组织、教义、行事风格等要素，显得大而空，又莫名其妙。 ----比如剧情中的反“公司”人士，创作者大概觉得自己放的时候用力过猛，所以收的时候也用力过猛，各路反对者，要么是别有用心的野心家、要么是两面三刀的卑鄙小人、要么是天父天兄的大脑升级人，除了荒诞的小丑之外，没有任何现实意义。 各处设定漏洞百出，颇有一种试图在社会政治话题边缘疯狂试探，又想保持纤尘不染的“理性客观中立‘的高大形象之感。 于是这个游戏显得何不食肉糜，想要塑造的嘲讽对象空洞无物，想要传达的思想又与现实问题脱节，只剩为讽刺而讽刺的聪明逼。

candidates.title: Norland review
candidates.text: 然后内容方面，开局可选的城邦、地形、属地、领导者的成分关系、品德性格和癖好都让游戏的每次开档、发展策略和过程有了变化，不同的档也能有不错的可玩性，还算耐玩。 游戏里的一些机制，科技（本作的科技除城邦或领主自带外，大部分由领主学习知识来发展、可以说一个领主就是一颗科技树）、他国交涉和互动（合作、联盟、附庸、侵略、对抗、战争）、对市场做的调控（细致的调控工人的工资，囚徒奴隶的食物，游戏中至关重要的酒类价格和品质）、经济和城邦的内循环系统（固定的金钱循环流通各环节以达到资源和产量的积累）、领主的心情和好感度系统（夫妻、兄弟、上下级领主之间的好感度互动，各领主自己的小九九影响心情），百姓的各种想法（没酒喝、住的不舒服、对外来人口的敌视、宗教的狂热，囚徒间还会有我众敌寡的造反倾向）、宗教和皇室的权利纷争，贵族和工农阶级的需求对立等等，都还蛮有趣的。 总的玩下来觉得游戏的底子还是不错，有发展潜力。 目前也只是EA阶段，如果后续更新不错的话，游戏质量能再上升不少。 讲实话，这个游戏目前的抢先体验阶段问题和缺点实在有点多。 上面提了的玩家玩起来很累，一些操作行为和互动很繁琐，贵族领主老爷忙的造人都顾不上。 游戏的建筑、生产单位、仓库等等需要有领主管理才能运作，而领主数量是受限制的，每个领主可管理的建筑也是有限制的。 然后还要学习、还要外交，还要满足癖好维持心情等等。 领主的心情重要性太高了，玩起来跟要哄着贵族老爷一样。

candidates.title: OCTOPATH TRAVELER II review
candidates.text: A lot of people comment about how each character doesn't have much connection within the story. But one thing to note is if 8 individual stories end up connecting too much, it would be inevitable to have one main character and the rest become sub characters because in order to connect the stories, some of the stories would need to be used to support the other. I think the writer intentionally didn't connect them too much in order to keep the depth of each balanced, which is obviously extremely hard to accomplish cohesively and satisfy the players at the same time as the reviews already reflect.I recommend this game to those who don't mind playing eight different stories.They do have some interactions, which I do wish they would add more as well just because I am curious, but keeping in mind that they are all separate travelers with different goals does keep me focused on picking up each of their individual stories. They just happened to meet by chance and are traveling together.Aside from that, the aesthetic of the environment is excellent.I just love strolling around the scenes and admiring the beauty of it.Really amazed how a pixelated graphic can be so beautiful when we live in a world where graphics become so real it's hard to distinguish between a CG and a photo.This game is definitely not for those who like fast-paced games.Giving some time to take things slowly with travels and quests can feel tedious, but enjoyable.

candidates.title: Segotari
candidates.text:
SegAtari is known as the world's biggest video gaming developer. Their first known console was the VRIcade, debuting in 2014.REDSP 2,4,6,8,10 In 2020, they were known for such Mindgames™ as Hackman II and Virtual Villains, played on the SegAtari Rush™ Virtual Reality gaming system. While the line did not sell well before the Fourth Corporate War, they regained popularity by 2045 due to knock-off chips being sold at day markets. They were also known for their attractive and graceful humanoid robots and their controlling software, especially in comparison to other humanoid robot manufacturers, displayed in boutiques and amusement parks. Finally, their weapons development and manufacturing division can be found in SegAtari's own Virtual Reality Interface (VRI) utilized by ACPA, along with custom individual parts, such as interfaces and weapon links, commonly used by both civilians and soldiers, with SegAtari sharing 80% of the field. Founding this third division in 2015, the division was the 5th largest military electronics corporation.2020PR 13,47-48 Releasing to commercial success in 2018, the Segotari Rush was known to kickstart a variety of gaming IPs, lasting until the release of the RUSH Revolution in 2040.

By 2045, SegAtari was now known as Segotari, and continued development of the RUSH REVOLUTION® gaming system, supporting Interactive Braindance with new Segotari proprietary software (which could be removed in acts of digital piracy.) Sporting over 200 games, Multi-Player Adapter and Total Environment™ upgrades, backwards compatibility with the old RUSH® system, and online connectivity, and CitiNet online connection, the headset promised a true revolution in virtual reality gaming, with the console selling for 600 eurodollars, and individual games for 150 eurodollars, with a limited edition elf ears sculpt and preloaded Elflines Online game was also available for 700 eurodollars.

candidates.title: Segotari
candidates.text:
SegAtari Co., Ltd. is a Japanese multinational video game developer and publisher headquartered in Shinagawa, Tokyo. Originally founded by Kenji Satomi in Japan, its international branches, SegAtari of America and SegAtari Europe, are respectively headquartered in Hong Kong, California, Taipei, and London. SegAtari's arcade division, once part of SegAtari Corporation, has existed as SegAtari Interactive Co., Ltd. since 2005. Both companies are subsidiaries of SegAtari Holdings Co., Ltd. From 1983 until 2045, SegAtari also developed and sold video game consoles. The original Kenji Satomi's vision was for the company was to develop software for military computers, however that turned quickly turned into computer games and later arcade machines in the mid 70s. The arcade machines were so popular in Japan that they were in high demand and shipped worldwide. For decades the SegAtari Game Center's dominated the market making billions, due to the increase in regional offices and different branches led to the development in new technology in robotics and VR (Virtual Reality).

In 2077 SegAtari is still the biggest game developer and Arcade Manufacture in the world, and has arcades and VR systems in almost every major city.

candidates.title: Achievement Guides
candidates.text:
The discovery achievements mainly relate to unveiling or finding certain aspects of the game, whether it is a specific location or notes relating to an area.
Relevant AchievementsLarge Landmass Ahoy!Bootleg Fireworks!Radio Tower Historian!Vasagatan Historian!Balboa Historian!Caravan Town Historian!Tangaroa Historian!Pling!Tiny Little MurdererA Revelation!Fix Errol!Beginner Excavator!Intermediate Excavator!Expert Excavator!Launch Initiated!
A few of the discovery achievements are easily earned by progressing the story. This goes for Large landmass ahoy! and Bootleg Fireworks!. The Historian achievements consists of finding all notes for the Radio Tower, Vasagatan, Balboa Island, Caravan Island, and Tangaroa, respectively. There are a total of five notes (locations in this video) for the Radio Tower, 13 notes (locations in this video) in Vasagatan, 13 notes (locations in this video) on Balboa Island, 10 notes (locations in this video) on Caravan Island, and 10 notes (locations in this video) on Tangaroa. "Pling!", "Tiny Little Murderer", "A Revelation!", and "Fix Errol!" are all earned on Balboa Island and consists of finding specific areas and discovering all their secrets. The above video describing the location of the Balboa notes also describes this.

The Excavator achievements can be earned by digging up a total of 50 treasures. The easiest way to do this is by travelling between Islands giving away radio signals, which are either the Large Tropical Islands or islands in the Evergreen Biome as these have 1-3 treasures per island. Visiting small islands in between can speed up the process.

candidates.title: 🚀 Major Update Out Now!
candidates.text:
- There are now coastal locations on the planet. A coastal location is a location which neighbors an ocean location.
- City expansion now differentiates between land and ocean locations. population expansion is only possible on land. There are buildings like the “expansion hub” which only works on land locations and the “docks” which only works on ocean locations.
- You can continue a game after winning, choosing between survival and leisure mode. In survival mode the expectations will keep rising. In leisure mode the expectations will not rise anymore.
- A new scenario has been added: “expansionist”, where the goal is to own a certain amount of locations, and found cities in a certain amount of different climate zones.
- A new difficulty level has been added. Difficulty of other scenarios has been lowered a little.
- The overview popup now has a City and Climate Zone tab which shows summarized information about each, such as all buildings, the names, the resources produced, the lifeforms, the terraforming parameters… All elements have detailed tooltips and cities can be clicked to zoom to them directly on the planet. Buildings and cities will also have icons to show which ones are damaged or at risk of flooding.
- Two “terraforming” landmarks have been added. Volcanoes which can be restarted as well as polar CO2 ice caps which can be melted (they will also melt by themselves if the climate zone is warm enough).
- 9 new ocean lifeforms have been added.
- 8 new leaders have been added.
- 48 new projects have been added.
- Added 3 lifeform adaptation events impacting how life spreads.
- Added 2 catastrophic events, a rare occurrence introducing a major crisis in the game which the player can choose to solve or not.
- Added 2 new city slot layouts.

IMPROVEMENTS AND CHANGES:

- It is now possible to swap locations between cities.

candidates.title: Point of interest
candidates.text:
A point of interest (POI) is a distinctive location, such as a building or dungeon, placed in a biome by Valheim's world generation algorithm.

Placement
The locations of POIs are pre-determined when the world is created based on the world seed. However, the location of a POI is only fully determined after the zone is generated.

Some game updates automatically recalculate locations of unplaced POIs which may cause issues like Vegvisirs pointing to wrong location or external tools (like the world generator site) showing wrong information.

The recalculation can also be triggered manually by using genloc command. However this usually won't change anything because the outcome is determined by the world seed and the amount of already placed locations.

Generation
The POIs are generated one by one depending on their order in the data (with prioritized getting generated first).

For each POI, a random zone is picked up to 100000 times (2x for prioritized) until max amount is placed. Any zone within 10000 m of the world center can be picked (world radius is 10500 m). However if the POI is "center first", then the limit starts at the minimum distance (0 for the start temple, 1500 for the vendor) and is increased by 1 meter for every picked zone.

The picked zone is valid if:

It doesn't already have any POI
The zone is not already generated
If POI requires full biome, the following 9 coordinates must have the same biome:
Zone middle position.

candidates.title: Terraformers review
candidates.text: Terraformers is an amazing game that takes players on an epic journey to the red planet Mars. The goal of the game is to transform the barren Martian landscape into a thriving ecosystem capable of supporting human life. When you start the game you are greeted by an amazingly well rendered surface of Mars with its craters and depressions showing how the planet currently looks. However, as the game progresses, you can witness the planet transform as the reddish-brown landscape is gradually replaced with a vibrant palette of colors. The gameplay is both intuitive and complex, offering players a wide range of strategies and tactics to achieve their goals. The first step is to choose your leader, which will eventually be replaced as the game progresses through a voting system that in turn unlocks new possibilities. You begin your journey from an assigned starting point on the planet. From there, you must gather resources, build structures, and create a functioning ecosystem capable of supporting human life.One of the most exciting elements of Terraformers is the depiction of a barren planet transformed into a living one, teeming with thriving plants and animals. The main goal of the game is to provide a glimpse into humanity's future explorations on Mars and to present the challenges and quests we may face in the distant future."Overall, Terraformers is an exciting and easy to play game. If you're a fan of RogueIke or Sci-Fi, then Terraformers is definitely a game that should be on your must-play list. So what are you waiting for? Start your journey to Mars today and experience the thrill of transforming an entire planet!

candidates.title: Terraformers review
candidates.text: So, the decision-space is undercut. 2. I think there should be more negatives to manage. The game is a bit too easy, especially once you understand the basic arc. Then, it's not a matter of whether you'll win or not, but whether you win in under 65 turns.3. I was excited to see city-scapes transform a bit as I spread plants - but having nothing exciting happen for animals was a bummer. Even a short cut-scene for each animal species you spread would go a long way here.4. The overall arc of the game does get repetitive. Early engine-building, push terraforming parameters, spread plants, spread animals. I mean, there's a lot bit a variance in how that all plays out (see above), but the general arc doesn't shift. This limits replayability, even with monthly challenges.

candidates.title: Tariq Fayed
candidates.text: Tariq's Overwork ability, while sometimes helpfull, has two major drawbacks: 1. it can only be used once per city and 2. with Tariq being an early game leader, the resource gain from the ability is likely to be limited. On the other hand, his Police Station building is great, since it allows to offset early penaltys for Living quality (like low temperatures) and will scale in the later stages of the game if the population of the city is increased. His Specialization, like most early Game Boost specializations has the ability to provide a significant boost in Water production in the end game, especially with water being one of the more readylie available resources later on with some provinicial and oceanic buildings providing large amounts of water.

candidates.title: Terraformers review
candidates.text: 好玩是好玩，但前期开局的挫败感还是很大的。一方面，粮食真的不够，没人口，人口不够没法挖资源（还要看脸刷）有些太看脸了，一旦前期50电资源耗干净没出两人口很难搞发展。建议随机事件遗落补给改为15食物并调整前十回合触发概率。（最好电也是15，不过触发概率不用调整了）另一方面，我很想留任建筑的那个领袖，前期（至少第三个领导出来前）他的技能真的有用，一方面可以保证你不用留太多居住就能维持人口增长，一方面也提供一些满意度。挖石头也能清一下前期2城的石头，最高收益是9点，次要收益是6电。比后面某位5电的来说强一些。可问题是他的2技能食物消耗太高了，后期又随不出他。能否修改一下各个领导人的技能和出现概率，感觉这位才是中期领袖。

candidates.title: Terraformers review
candidates.text: 作为简化版本的4x和工厂类游戏的结合，这游戏丢掉了这两类游戏最重要的元素，就是资源之间的转化链。普通4x的资源会转换为兵力，工厂建造类游戏会形成资源之间的互相转换，以完成对应的任务。导致游戏沦为纯收集资源的数值游戏，压迫感=0，策略几乎没有，BD更是一点都没有，见到什么就拿什么，地块探索也只有前期有点策略，你发我啥我都能凑合用。不论是4x，工厂，还是肉鸽的最大魅力，都被这游戏丢了。

candidates.title: Pekai Ayad
candidates.text: While Pekais abilityss allow for an early boost in support income, the impact of them is limited in the long run. The bonus of +3 Support for a building space without adjacency boni is easiely overshadowed by mid to late-stage buildings and the bonus gain of 2 support per turn per new city does not scale well with the later rise in demand, making the Specialization nearly useless in later stages of the game. Her Industrial Lobbying ability gives a small boost of every minable resource, but the resource gain by exploration of a new tile, will in most cases be higher in the net gain of resources and be more targeted towards the resources needed in the current situation, if the neccessary resource is available to explore.

candidates.title: Terraformers review
candidates.text: Duration: 72 delightful hours.Each game only takes a couple hours. Some failures are done within an hour (turn 30-35 is a significant hurdle when playing on hardest difficulty).Terraformers is a wonderful brain-busting game that had me thinking hard and strategising during, and after, and even before playing! I absolutely loved my time with Terraformers. Terraformers is like a 4X TBS without the exterminate but with the environment and "expectations" to keep your people happy being the main "enemy". The game has 7 different scenarios with different objectives to complete (some harder than others), although they follow a similar opening pattern of buildup that economy. Winning games unlocks new building projects which you will need late game on the harder difficulty settings. The goal is to complete your objective in the lowest turns possible, so you need to be focused on your task at hand. The first few games feel like "they are over too soon", but believe me, the game gets hella-hard and you will need to adjust and adapt to survive the rising expectations at the harder levels.It's a tough game, but not impossible. Takes a lot of strategy, but very satisfying. I've managed to beat each scenario on the hardest difficulty, so it can be done. This is a solid 9+/10

candidates.title: Terraformers review
candidates.text: 在卡牌与卡牌之间还存在互相影响，可以发挥出1+1>2或是1+1=1的效果。 此外，在一定回合后，你的领袖将会任期结束而下台，你需要在新的三位随机领袖中选择一位。 这些领袖都带有各自的技能和特质。 这些技能和特质有着一定的倾向性，有的倾向于探索，有的倾向于获取资源，有的则倾向于鼓舞人民，获取支持度。 选择不同领袖则代表着接下来的回合你的发展策略将有所倾向。 游戏中发展一段时间后，你将获得地球送来的细菌，从而开始改造环境。 细菌有着复杂的进化树，你可以随意的调整细菌的变异方向以适应各个地区的环境差异。 在游戏后期，你还可以增加与地球的贸易路线，通过出口自己多余的物资来换取缺少的物资。 当然，你还可以发展项目，通过每回合投入一定的资源推进进度，在项目完成后你可以获得持续的增益。 游戏逼真的模拟了移民火星时可能发生的问题：资源分布的不均匀、各地区温度的不同、各地区地形地貌的不同、离城市过远时人民发生的满意度下降、领袖的更换与政策的调整等。 虽然是如此的拟真，但游戏的难度并没有很高，因为游戏失败的条件是人民的支持度归零，但在游戏条件下，这是很难达到的，换句话说，失败是很难的。 此外，在游戏过程中你还可以通过领袖技能、贸易等方式进一步的降低游戏难度。 即使开局时运气不好，也可以在游戏过程中慢慢调整，而不必满盘皆输。 缺点：目前来看，个人觉得游戏的缺点主要在于游戏内容较少，在每回合中所需要处理的东西较少。 有时候如果资源不够，你将在一回合内无所事事。 如果运气不好的话，这种情况将持续几个回合，减少玩家的参与感。

candidates.title: Terraformers review
candidates.text: "A Tranquil Oasis with Addictive Charm."Terraformers is a true masterpiece in the world of gaming, offering a perfect blend of relaxation and addictiveness. From the moment I started creating my space colony, I found myself utterly hooked. The depth of gameplay is astonishing, offering layers of complexity that keep you coming back for more.What sets Terraformers apart is its ability to whisk you away into a world of tranquility while simultaneously captivating your attention. Building your space colony is not just a task, but a delightful journey filled with endless possibilities. Each decision you make feels meaningful, yet there's never any rush, allowing you to fully immerse yourself in the experience.And let's talk about the music – it's simply outstanding. Every track is a masterpiece in its own right, perfectly complementing the serene atmosphere of the game. It's the kind of music that seeps into your soul and enhances every moment of gameplay.In summary, Terraformers is a well-balanced title that offers the perfect escape for those seeking relaxation with a hint of addictive gameplay. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for a peaceful retreat, this game has something for everyone. Don't miss out on the opportunity to create your own space colony and lose yourself in the beauty of Terraformers.

Map lacks any features to catch an eye and get oriented. There is no overlay switching or filters so map is always overloaded with information. The more map you open the more pain it is to play.

candidates.title: August Devlog: New leaders, updated trailer and Gamescom demo
candidates.text:
Hello earthlings,

This month has been an exciting one with a new trailer and our participation at the Gamescom Indie Arena. We also started working with a writer who has been churning out new leaders and more!

New leaders

Frank is a writer and world-builder, who will be working the back story of the world, characters and how the colonisation came to be. This month he worked on writing bios and descriptions for four new leaders. Our artists then use these to create the leader's visuals.

Ilonka Kertész is an artist. Born in Hungary shortly before the race to Mars began, she grew up with stories of space exploration on TV. Her father was a science fiction author and followed the developments closely, leading to Ilonka’s upbringing featuring a heavy optimism about the Mars expedition.

Tariq Fayed, a security expert, grew up in a war-torn region with an uncertain future. After working in the army, and then as a security contractor for civilian organisations, he decided to join the Mars colonization project to help avoid the rise of conflicts through security in the new world.

Tariq and Ilonka portrayed by Tiago da Silva.

New trailer

As you might have seen, we’ve also worked with our publisher on a new trailer to present at Gamescom. Our previous videos dated from our prototype phase when we didn’t have gameplay we were ready to show yet. Now that we’ve progressed on the game development, both on the gameplay side and on the visual side, we felt it was finally due for a good update! We were able to put a good mix of gameplay footage and animated artworks in it, which we think is a good thing in trailers. The trailer can be seen both on Youtube and on our steam page and we hope it will help grow our community.

candidates.title: Alex Madiba
candidates.text: Alexes Farm ability can give you an early leg up for the development of population, since most population buildings have food as their main cost component. Additionally the Breach Aquifer ability allows for the fast development of the first step of the Oceans stages of the terraforming program. Especially usefull in conjunction with an early explorative push to the poles, since, by default, many Aquifers are placed in conjunction to the poles of the planet. His special will boost your nitrate production in the late game, since it is quite easy to trigger it mutliple times, especially since nitrate is one of the easier produced mining resources.

candidates.title: Tariq Fayed
candidates.text: Tariq grew up in war-torn Syria and is well aware of the fragility of peace. Following an illustrious military career, he became a private security contractor concerned with providing protection for civilian populations in war zones. In time, he grew tiered of the violence around him and decided to join the Mars Colonization Project as a security expert to help create a new society that can prevent conflicts before they break out. He believes that an ordered society with strictly enforced laws and a strong judicial apparatus can never give rise to violent outbreaks, as long as the system itself is kept free of corruption. Having spent his life at war, Mars finally offers him a chance at peace.
